newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lion says sales will drop in first half.
newsitem.headline: Lion says sales will drop in first half.

text.p: Lion Nathan Ltd expects to report a two to three percent drop in beer sales when it reports its first half result and a drop of four to five percent over the year, Corporate Treasurer Jamie Tomlinson said on Friday.
"The beer market is down significantly for the quarter and for the half year," Tomlinson told Reuters.

Tomlinson cited very poor weather, especially in Auckland, declining per capita consumption, increased discretionary spending on gaming, the anti drink-drive campaign on television and increased random breath testing as reasons for the fall.
At 1.50 p.m. (0150 GMT) on Friday, Lion Nathan shares were trading at NZ$3.32, down six cents, reflecting brokers' earnings downgrades.
Lion reports its first half result on April 28.
